scripts.build:local: npm run build:storefront && shopify app build --config local
scripts.build:test: npm run build:storefront && shopify app build --config test
scripts.build:production: npm run build:storefront && shopify app build --config production
scripts.dev:test-store:clean: shopify app dev clean --config local --store macfoxebike.myshopify.com
scripts.check: npm run check:config && npm run build:local
scripts.check:config: shopify app config validate --config local --json && shopify app config validate --config test --json && shopify app config validate --config production --json
